name: ユーザー作成・招待を始める一覧ヘッダー操作群
prompt: Second pass for the same small Japanese Snowflake header action group. Use the supplied source crop as the geometric and color authority; use the first candidate only to preserve its Japanese wording and overall treatment. Keep the final canvas exactly 204 x 43 px. Match the blue Invite button to the source bounds x=124..203 and y=2..42 (80 x 41 px), flush to the right edge, with the same roughly 8 px corner radius. Shift the left edge 3 px left, add 5 px to the button width, and move the button down 1 px relative to the first candidate. Keep the button blue close to the source's medium royal blue (approximately RGB 37,116,226), avoiding a brighter electric blue. Preserve the white semibold 「招待」 centered at x=164. Keep the muted blue-gray text action 「ユーザーを作成」 on one line, centered near x=54, vertically centered, clean Japanese sans-serif around 14 px medium weight. White or very pale neutral background. No shadows, gradients, icons, borders, extra labels, or outer canvas. The finished image contains only this action group.
reviewNotes: 文字と色は保たれるが、青い招待ボタンがx=118..202,y=0..39となり、原図x=124..203,y=2..42より左へ6px、幅が5px広く、高さも3px低い。第1版の方が近いため両方とも要修正として記録。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: first candidate; retain Japanese wording only
